messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(1 comment)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Looks good. The removal is safe: neither helper has a caller anywhere in the tree, and extent_prev() itself is still used (ldlm_extent_shift_kms() and ofd_intent_cb()), so nothing is orphaned by dropping extent_prev_lock(). Worth noting that extent_replace() was also broken as written - it copies the rb_left/rb_right/parent-colour links but never copies l_subtree_last, so the augmented interval-tree data would have gone stale the first time it was wired up. One inline note with evidence for the open question about extent_prev_lock().

LU-16518 ldlm: remove unused extent rbtree helpers

... since they are no longer used. extent_prev_lock() and
extent_replace() were never called after being introduced.

Fixes: 0cf356c4e427 ("LU-11085 ldlm: optimise extent locks with identical extent")
